format: html
editor: visual

#import file

```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

#Put in file names
cipro_BZB_1.5h <- read_excel("11.4_Cipro_BZB_2rdRun.xlsx", sheet="first")
cipro_BZB_15h <- read_excel("11.4_Cipro_BZB_2rdRun.xlsx", sheet="second")
key_ref <- read_excel("11.4_Cipro_BZB_2rdRun.xlsx", sheet="keys")
```

#clean and combine

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr.")

cipro_BZB_1.5h$"Cycle Nr." <- as.numeric(cipro_BZB_1.5h$"Cycle Nr.")
```

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr." <- cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle Nr." + 90
```

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Time [s]" <- cipro_BZB_15h$"Time [s]" + 5400

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(cipro_BZB_1.5h, cipro_BZB_15h)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- combined_df %>%
  select(-3)%>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean <- pivoted_OD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(`Time [s]`/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  rename(Cycle=`Cycle Nr.`,
         Time_s=`Time [s]`)%>%
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything())
  
```

#add a key col

```{r}
df_clean<- left_join(df_clean, key_ref[, c("well_ID", "key", "cipro_ug_mL", "trial", "trial_rep", "trial_ID")], by = "well_ID")

df_clean$cipro_ug_mL<-factor(as.numeric(df_clean$cipro_ug_mL))

```

#calculate mean from replicates

```{r}
df_summarise <- df_clean %>%
  filter(trial != "test") %>%
  group_by(Time_h, trial, cipro_ug_mL) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(CV = sd/mean)

```

#plot curves

```{r}
BZB_H_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(trial == "H") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, color = cipro_ug_mL, group =cipro_ug_mL), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^5/mL per well",
        y="Mean OD",
        caption = str_wrap("Cipro conc. is diluted by 2-fold; Growth control: cipro conc.= 0; MHB-only blank: cipro conc.= NA", width = 35))

BZB_H_curve

#set working directory before saving!
ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_2ndRun_H_110426.png", plot = BZB_H_curve, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
BZB_L_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(trial == "L") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, color = cipro_ug_mL, group =cipro_ug_mL), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^3/mL per well",
        y="Mean OD",
        caption = str_wrap("Cipro conc. is diluted by 2-fold; Growth control: cipro conc.= 0; MHB-only blank: cipro conc.= NA; Well D-12 got contaminated", width = 35))

BZB_L_curve

ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_2ndRun_L_110426.png", plot = BZB_L_curve, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

## curves of replicates

```{r}
BZB_H_reps<- df_clean |>
  filter(trial == "H") |>
ggplot(aes(x = Time_h, y = OD, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~trial_rep)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve Triplicate",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^5/mL per well; cipro-H2O stock",
        y="OD",
        caption = str_wrap("Cipro conc. is diluted by 2-fold; Growth control: cipro conc.= 0; MHB-only blank: cipro conc.= NA", width = 35))
```
